scenarios.description: Verify pane-bound preference coverage, native CLI discovery, Settings navigation and save acknowledgements.
scenarios.userEntryPoint: Open Settings, navigate to Permissions, Labs or Handoff, and change a switch. Check the result and recover from a refused change.
prerequisites: Node 22, the locked frontend and dependency policy packages, the pinned Bend toolchain, Electron and Xvfb.
A candidate checkout with its normal Settings renderer build.
expectedEvidence: The Bend coverage check requires generated pane IDs, production bindings and round-trip samples. Negative fixtures reject invalid paths and writes.
Electron fixtures report successful navigation, keyboard changes, save acknowledgement and recovery. The Recording smoke also exercises Settings → Handoff → Auto paste.
The native release check verifies discovery and direct CLI round trips with an isolated config.
limits: The Electron parent is synthetic. Native OS effects and installer behavior require their owning checks.

scenarios.description: Verify that AppImage packaging stages Settings and popup assets from one fresh frontend build.
scenarios.userEntryPoint: Run capture/desktop/scripts/linux/appimage/appimage.sh with a built Apparent binary.
prerequisites: Node 22, Bash and the standard Linux command-line tools for the synthetic routing test.
expectedEvidence: The packaging script calls the synthetic Settings producer once and stages fresh Settings and popup assets in their AppDir paths.
limits: The fixture substitutes the frontend build and linuxdeploy. Hosted packaging and the public AppImage verify the real payload.

scenarios.description: Verify the Agents pane after retirement of the video-proof preference.
scenarios.userEntryPoint: Open Settings → Agents. Copy the skill command and change Send recordings to T3 Code.
prerequisites: The candidate Settings renderer built with locked dependencies and Electron.
Xvfb on Linux for the renderer fixture.
expectedEvidence: The pane has the skill command and T3 switch. The video-proof control is absent.
Keyboard copying, acknowledged T3 saves, and recovery still work. The native round trip preserves old video-proof config keys.
limits: The renderer smoke uses a fixture parent. Run the separate Rust round trip for the actual Settings writer.
